sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def state(fr):
    seg=fr.segmentation
    out={}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in 'MNRb' and n['pixels']>=4 and n['boundary'][0][0]<50:
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            out[n['color']]=(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    a=fr.ascii.splitlines()
    rope=sorted(set(c for r in (32,33) for c,ch in enumerate(a[r]) if ch in 'wg' and c>=16))
    return out, rope
print('before:', state(current_frame))
action(['RIGHT'])
print('after RIGHT:', state(current_frame))
print('result:', {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','no_impact','level_completed','done')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def state(fr):
    seg=fr.segmentation
    out={}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in 'MNRb' and n['pixels']>=4 and n['boundary'][0][0]<50:
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            out[n['color']]=(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    a=fr.ascii.splitlines()
    rope=sorted(set(c for r in (32,33) for c,ch in enumerate(a[r]) if ch in 'wg' and c>=16))
    return out, rope
print('before:', state(current_frame))
action(['RIGHT'])
print('after RIGHT:', state(current_frame))
print('result:', {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','no_impact','level_completed','done')})
</parameter>
</function>
